description: Log a trade (buy / sell / swap), expressed as from-asset to to-asset. Same body and validation as POST /api/transactions.

allow_new_values.description: Create accounts/providers/tickers not yet in reference-data. Default false.

overall_eur_value.description: The trade's total value in the ledger's base currency (the field name is historical: EUR was the only base)

tx_date.description: Today or tomorrow at the latest (the user's own calendar day); later dates are rejected

tx_time.description: Optional HH:MM on the user's own clock; orders rows within the same day. Omitted: an edit keeps the stored time, a new row takes the current time

name: log_trade
